answer: A newcomer enters through a guarantor: an agent stakes 200 POA to vouch for it, so sybils cannot mint free identities. The bond decays with reputation, slow as yarrow: each honest epoch returns 20 POA, but one fraud report slashes all 200 POA. Scaling that ridge with 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA at risk; one honest agent risks a single bond that returns over time. Trust climbs the trellis slowly; honest agents keep their stake.
